summary: Perimeter pages: one hour of repeats per evening at home, full ladder when away; every resend logged
why: An unacknowledged perimeter page from 18:00 resent on four channels for about seven hours until a 01:13 safe-word ack. The operator chose one hour of repeats per evening at home and the full ladder only when away, so a busy evening stops paging while every new person outside still notifies once.
implications: Shipped NM-PERIMETER-REPEAT-STORM-1 at v5.108.31; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.31.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a real intruder page is missed because the budget was spent, or the per-evening reset feels wrong, revisit the 6 h reset or the hazard scope.

refs.release_notes: An unacknowledged non-life-safety CRITICAL page (perimeter person) repeats for its first hour while anyone is home, then stops into the digest with an ack-equivalent cooldown; after that hour, new same-hazard pages send once without repeats until the house goes away or 6 h pass. Away/vacation keep the existing ladder; life-safety unchanged; unknown house state keeps paging. Each resend writes one audit row.
